modes.name: Walking
modes.description: The classic bipedal locomotion method
modes.fun_description: One foot in front of the other. Repeat for millions of years. What could go wrong?

modes.name: Running
modes.description: Faster bipedal locomotion, but you'll get tired
modes.fun_description: Run, Forrest, run! Just not for 500,000 years straight.

modes.name: Bicycle
modes.description: More efficient than walking, but where do you put the snacks?
modes.fun_description: The most efficient human-powered vehicle. Pity there are no roads in space.

modes.name: Chemical Rocket
modes.description: Classic rocket propulsion using chemical reactions
modes.fun_description: The tried and true method of exploding your way to the stars. Very loud, very fast, very expensive.

modes.name: Ion Drive
modes.description: Efficient electric propulsion with very low thrust
modes.fun_description: Painfully slow acceleration, but incredibly efficient. Pack a lot of books.

modes.name: Nuclear Thermal Rocket
modes.description: Heat propellant with a nuclear reactor
modes.fun_description: Why use chemical explosions when you can use nuclear ones? (Please sign this waiver.)

modes.name: Solar Sail
modes.description: Propelled by sunlight pressure on large reflective sails
modes.fun_description: Sailing the cosmic sea with nothing but light. Very romantic, very slow.

modes.name: Nuclear Pulse Propulsion
modes.description: Ride the shockwaves of nuclear explosions
modes.fun_description: Explode nuclear bombs behind you and surf the shockwave. What could possibly go wrong?

modes.name: Fusion Drive
modes.description: Harness the power of stellar fusion for propulsion
modes.fun_description: Always 20 years away from being practical! Cruising at a fraction of light speed.

modes.name: Giant Slingshot
modes.description: A Y-shaped launcher the size of Mount Everest
modes.fun_description: NASA's most budget-friendly option. Drawbacks: instant death from G-forces and no steering.

modes.name: Cosmic Hitchhiking
modes.description: Stick out your thumb and hope for the best
modes.fun_description: Don't panic! Just stick out your thumb and wait. Always know where your towel is.

modes.name: Space Elevator
modes.description: A cable stretching from surface to orbit
modes.fun_description: Great views during the 2-year climb! Note: You're still just in orbit, not going anywhere.

modes.name: Garden Snail
modes.description: Mounting a space-suited garden snail
modes.fun_description: Slower than continental drift. Bring enough lettuce for several geological epochs.

modes.name: Space Stallion
modes.description: Riding an equine companion in a pressurized space saddle
modes.fun_description: Galloping through the void. Giddy up, Space Cowboy!

modes.name: Hover Skateboard
modes.description: Kick-flipping across the heliocentric plane
modes.fun_description: Doing a 360-flip over the asteroid belt. Rad, but oxygen is short.

modes.name: Solar Hot Air Balloon
modes.description: Catching solar wind gusts in a giant thermal balloon
modes.fun_description: Gently drifting through interplanetary space in a wicker basket.

modes.name: Giant Cannon
modes.description: Jules Verne style ballistic shell launch
modes.fun_description: Packed into a metal bullet and fired into space. Helmets strongly recommended.

modes.name: Cosmic Catapult
modes.description: A colossal medieval trebuchet stationed on Earth's Moon
modes.fun_description: Flinging 90kg walkers across 300 million kilometers using counterweights.

modes.name: Asteroid Riding
modes.description: Harpooning a passing asteroid and riding its natural orbit
modes.fun_description: Yeehaw! Hitch a ride on a multi-gigaton rock traveling across the belt.

modes.name: Comet Riding
modes.description: Surfing the icy tail of a high-speed comet
modes.fun_description: Surfing a dirty snowball at 70 km/s. Cold, bumpy, but extremely fast!

modes.name: Teleportation
modes.description: Instant transmission of matter across space
modes.fun_description: Warning: May result in philosophical crises or arriving as a fine mist.

modes.name: Warp Drive
modes.description: Bend spacetime to travel faster than light
modes.fun_description: Requires negative mass. Ignore minor physics details and cross the galaxy in minutes!

modes.name: Hyperspace
modes.description: Travel through another dimension where physics is optional
modes.fun_description: Travel through a dimension where physics is more of a suggestion. Bring snacks!

modes.name: Magic Portal
modes.description: Stepping through an ancient glowing stone archway
modes.fun_description: One step in London, next step on Mars. Watch out for stray goblins.

modes.name: Black Hole Shortcut
modes.description: Diving into an Einstein-Rosen bridge wormhole
modes.fun_description: Survive spaghettification and emerge anywhere in the cosmos instantly.

modes.name: Instant Travel
modes.description: Omnipresent quantum state shifting
modes.fun_description: You are already there. Time elapsed: 0.00 seconds.

modes.name: Superhero Flight
modes.description: Flying through the vacuum with a red cape and outstretched arm
modes.fun_description: Soaring past Jupiter at Mach 100,000. No space suit required for superheroes.
